Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: An academic course or subject containing weekly lecture modules.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this subject.

code.description: Short course code such as CS101.

color.description: Accent color token name for the subject indicator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was last updated.

Week.title: Week
Week.description: A single academic week within a subject (e.g., Week 1 through Week 15).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this week.

subjectId.description: Document ID of the parent subject.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the week was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the week was last updated.

Lecture.title: Lecture
Lecture.description: A lecture containing raw transcript text and structured AI-generated study notes.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this lecture.

subjectId.description: Document ID of the parent subject.

weekId.description: Document ID of the parent week.

notesSummary.description: Concise executive summary of the lecture.

notesBullets.description: Structured key pointers and bullet notes (max 60 items).

notesDefinitions.description: Key term definitions extracted from the lecture (max 40 items).

notesExamples.description: Illustrative examples from the lecture (max 30 items).

tags.description: Study tags such as Important, Formula, Definition (max 10 items).

revisionReady.description: Whether the student has marked these notes as Revision Ready.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lecture was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lecture was last updated.

/subjects/{subjectId}.description: Top-level collection storing user-owned academic subjects.

/weeks/{weekId}.description: Top-level collection storing weeks linked to a parent subject.

/lectures/{lectureId}.description: Top-level collection storing lecture transcripts and generated study notes.
